🦅 Welcome to Fly Tower!
Fly, dive, and soar to the top! 🏔️ Can you beat every floor and become a Flight Legend?

How to Play:

🚀 Fly: Zoom through the air and cross big gaps!

🧗 Climb: Jump across bouncy mountain cliffs!
